{{Quote|Over there is our Sensory Gymnasium.|A hotelier to Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa guests|<ref name="SC 105" />}}
The '''Sensory Gymnasium''' was a facility located in<ref name="SC 105" /> [[Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa]]<ref name="Spa name">{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess/#!asset/bj8gqtnvm799njt6mjc6t|text=GR-FF-001420|date=2024-12-23}}</ref> on the [[planet]] [[Lanupa]] during the [[New Republic Era]].<ref name="SC 105" />

A former [[pirate]] world, [[Lanupa]] was visited by pirate [[Jod Na Nawood]]<ref name="SC 105" /> around [[9 ABY]].<ref name="SCDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> Accompanied by four [[youngling]]s,<ref name="SC 105" /> the [[Gender|man]]<ref name="SC 102 ST">{{SkeletonCrew|Way, Way Out Past the Barrier}} {{Subtitles|Disney+}}</ref> was shown around the [[hotel]] by its [[Unidentified Lanupa hotelier|director]], who pointed at the Sensory Gymnasium from afar. Unbeknownst to the hotelier, the guests were after [[Captain Rennod's Lair]], located somewhere within the hotel. As Jod and the children devised their operational plan in a suite later on, the man suggested that<ref name="SC 105" /> the girl<ref name="SC 101">{{SkeletonCrew|This Could Be a Real Adventure}}</ref> [[KB]] penetrate the Sensory Gymnasium after<ref name="SC 105" /> she refused to go to the [[spa]]. Finally, however, none of the off-worlders went to the Gymnasium due to task-distrubution issues.<ref name="SC 101" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sensory Gymnasium was first mentioned in "[[You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates]]," the fifth episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'',<ref name="SC 105" /> aired on [[December 24]], [[2024]].<ref name="Premiere">{{Twitter|StarWars|status/1861409832349172011|[[Star Wars]]|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/QwMYe}}</ref>
